Chapter 833: Chapter 29: Refining the Ultimate Weapon (Please Subscribe)

In a daze,

Lin Yuan opened his eyes. “I’m back…”

Feeling the immeasurable and vast rule fluctuations of the Main Universe, a smile emerged on Lin Yuan’s face.

In the final twenty-plus years in the Boundless Void, Lin Yuan’s comprehension of the laws had made slow progress.

One of the main reasons was that the sea of laws in the Boundless Void was too shallow....

You could see its limits at a glance.

But the Main Universe?

Lin Yuan saw the hope of a significant improvement in law comprehension. “In the Boundless Void, reaching the Sixth Realm of space-time is already the limit; the Seventh Realm is theoretically impossible to achieve.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Indeed, the Sixth Realm of space-time was as difficult as ascending to the heavens.

The reason why creators of secret realms and Children of the Void could step into the Tenth Stage was due to their innate endowment and talents.

But now,

Lin Yuan felt the even more vast and profound fluctuations of space-time beyond the Sixth Realm.

Of course, feeling it was one thing, and whether one could comprehend it was another matter altogether.

Just like how ordinary people see a towering mountain in the distance, seeing and reaching it are entirely different concepts.

After comprehending the Sixth Realm of space-time, Lin Yuan did not delve deeper.

Apart from the limitations of the Boundless Void, it was also because his own level was too low.

Comprehending the Sixth Realm at the Tenth Stage?

At least within the Main Universe, there were no known precedents, certainly none from before.

As for comprehending the Seventh Realm? Lin Yuan has no such ambition at the moment. “The space-time of the Cosmic Starry Skies is also too vast…”

At this moment, Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Cosmic Starry Skies had undergone a significant change compared to before his travels.

Before his tenth interdimensional travel, Lin Yuan’s realm in space-time was only at the Second Realm, but now he has reached the Sixth Realm, with every detail of space-time clearly visible. “It’s so vast and spectacular…”

Lin Yuan carefully observed, feeling awestruck within.

If the Boundless Void is considered a narrow space of several square meters, Lin Yuan would only need to take one step, or a few steps, to reach any point within it.

But the entire Cosmic Starry Skies is like a football field.

Even with the comprehension of the Sixth Realm, he couldn’t achieve the same ‘think and you are there’ as in the Boundless Void.

This is the difference in the breadth of space-time between the Main Universe and the Boundless Void.

In the Cosmic Starry Skies, not to mention that Lin Yuan’s mere comprehension of the Sixth Realm of space-time, even a Level Twelve supreme being couldn’t achieve ‘think and you are there’.

Within the vast territories of the Main Universe, there are occasionally dangerous spatial-temporal locations.

There exist layered Spatial-Temporal Mazes.

Even with the comprehension of the Sixth Realm, one cannot traverse directly. “But with my current control over space-time, plus the ‘Nine Steps of Space-Time’…” “Unless a strong being personally pursues me, I’m essentially invincible.”

Lin Yuan was certain in his heart.

Even if he couldn’t be omnipresent like he was in the Boundless Void, he had far surpassed his previous capabilities of spatial traversal in the Main Universe.

Together with the “Nine Steps of Space-Time”…

Not to mention beings beneath the supreme level, Lin Yuan had a feeling, even if a Level Twelve supreme being wanted to catch up to him, they would probably have to wait until the fifth or sixth step, or possibly only have a chance after the full nine steps.

The Profound Xuanhuang lineage’s survival Secret Technique “Nine Steps of Space-Time” was undoubtedly unmatched in terms of escape speed.

This was a Dao-Protecting Secret Skill created specifically for the descendants of the Profound Xuanhuang lineage by Xuanhuang, who roamed the Chaos Void. …

Although Lin Yuan was confident that supreme beings could not guarantee catching up to him within nine steps during an escape, he would not foolishly provoke a supreme being.

For a supreme being who wants to kill a being below the twelfth stage, why would they need to personally chase them down?

A single soul attack would be sufficient. … “Now my strength…”

Lin Yuan began to assess himself.

Before his tenth travel, Lin Yuan’s estimation of his combat strength was at the third or fourth tier of Level Eleven.

But now, even for legendary beings at Level Eleven Perfect, such as the Four Divine Kings, if they did not make use of supreme weapons, Lin Yuan could easily suppress them with a flick of his hand.

The Sixth Realm of space-time compared to the Fifth Realm is practically an overwhelming crush.

If the combat strength of a Level Eleven Perfect being is ten, and Evil Gods in the Boundless Void’s Tenth Stage are between fifteen to twenty, then Lin Yuan’s combat strength is around one hundred.

And for a Level Twelve supreme being, setting this as a standard, their strength would be in the hundreds of millions.

Although Lin Yuan still could not compare to a Level Twelve supreme being, he had also surpassed the normal Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings. …

In the Two-dimensional World, Lin Yuan used the environmental constraints of the Two-dimensional World to crush those Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings.

In reality, though, he was taking advantage of the situation.

But now,

Lin Yuan’s real combat strength had indeed surpassed Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings completely. …

Here, surpassing completely refers to those legendary beings relying purely on their own strength.

Compared to the Tenth Stage Evil Gods of the Boundless Void, the Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings in the Main Universe have a tremendous advantage.

That is weaponry.

The Four Divine Kings could integrate a supreme weapon to greatly level up their combat strength.

Other Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings also have hopes of acquiring a supreme weapon.

Most Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings in the Main Universe were backed by peak clans or a supreme being.

In order to improve the chances of reaching the ultimate level, peak clans or supreme beings would bestow a supreme weapon to allow the legendary being to pre-comprehend the power of the twelfth level.

This supreme weapon is only lent temporarily; if the recipient successfully enters the Level Twelve, it won’t be taken back, but if they fail, the weapon would return to the clan’s possession.

The reason the Four Divine Kings have such a big reputation among the many Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings in the Main Universe, is because of the supreme weapon they own, which is very compatible with them.
